issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

featureValuePrecision.description: How many digits after the decimal to round to for feature values displayed in the UI.

showModelSetupWithSensorAssociationUIFlo.description:
Flag to determine if the UI should show the model setup with {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.SensorAssociation} UI flows.
This flag will hide the following UI flows:
- Model setup with correlation side menu.
- Sensor Correlation Jobs Grid.
- Sensor Correlation Count Definition List.
- Correlation Parameters Tab.

showAssetDiagramAndChildGrid.description:
Flag controls whether the Asset Diagram and Child Grid are displayed
in the relevant Asset Details Page.
- If this flag is enabled (`true`), both the asset image (diagram) and the asset's child grid are shown.
- If disabled (`false`), neither the diagram nor the child grid will be displayed on the page.

topContributionsToShowOnRiskScoreChart.description: Number of top feature contributions to plot on the risk score chart by default.

reliabilityAssetAlertLimit.description:
The base limit for fetch call {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert}s on the following pages:
- Asset Detail Page > Asset Alerts Tab > Filter Panel
The default value is set to default value 2000 but can be increased.

defaultScatterPlotPeriod.description:
The default time period of data to plot for the Scatter Plot if the user saves the scatter plot configuration without
both start and end dates specified.

showUserDefinedMetricsFeature.description:
Flag to determine if the UI should show the User Defined Metrics feature
This flag will hide the following UI flows:
- Create Metric page
- Metric config page
- Metric field in the side panel of the Analysis/Timeseries page

showWorkOrderforSparePartsUIflows.description:
Flag to determine if the UI should show WorkOrders for Spare Parts.
This flag will hide the following UI flows:
- WorkOrderDetail
- WorkOrdersDefinitionList
- WorkOrdersSparePartsFilterPanel
- WorkOrdersSparePartsGrid
- SparePartsGrid
- PurchaseOrderLineGrid
- PurchaseOrderPartsForecastGrid
- SparePartsForecastChart
- SparePartsDefinitionList
- SparePartsHelpDocumentationSidePanel

showYAxisDataZoomForModelPredictionChart.description: Flag controls whether the data zoom functionality is enabled for the Y-axis in the Model Prediction chart.

topContributionsToShowOnResidualRiskAler.description:
Number of top feature contributions to plot on the charts by default.
This is the replacement for topContributionsToShowOnRiskScoreChart as we move to the project agnostic paradigm.

show3DModelForAssetDetail.description: Flag controls whether the data zoom functionality is enabled for the Y-axis in the Asset Detail Model OutPut Chart.

modelClassificationLabelConfig.description:
A list of {@link ThresholdConfig}s which is used to configure a mapping between
{@link ReliabilityMlModel.ClassificationScore#value}, {@link ReliabilityMlModel#classificationLabel} and the corresponding color.
The values are also considered to be inclusive upper bounds for a given classification label.

Note: [*Order Matters*] The ThresholdConfig entry at index 0 in modelClassificationLabelConfig corresponds to the
lowest possible {@link ReliabilityMlModel.ClassificationScore#value}.
The entries in the array are expected be in ascending order of {@link ReliabilityMlModel.ClassificationScore#value}.

chartTooltipDecimalPrecision.description: How many digits after the decimal to round to for chart tooltip values displayed in the UI.

sensorLimit.description:
The base limit for fetch call {@link Sensor} on the following pages:
- Alert Page > Alert Details > Filter Panel
The default value is set to default value 2000 but can be increased.

showYAxisDataZoomForAssetDataPreparation.description: Flag controls whether the data zoom functionality is enabled for the Y-axis in the Asset Data Preparation chart.

featureFetchBaseLimit.description: The Base Limit for fetch call FeatureFetchBase#fetchFeatures. The default value is set to default value 2000 but can be increased.

hierarchyViewerAssetFetchLimit.description:
The maximum number of {@link ReliabilityAsset}s that can be fetched in the Asset Hierarchy Viewer through filter panel.
The default value is set 50 but can be increased.

defaultPreviewExperimentalModelChartInte.description:
The default interval for the experimental model chart.

@see ReliabilityMlModel#persistExperimentProcessAndInterpretOutputs

minDataPointsForAutoInterval.description:
The minimum number of data points that each series should have for the auto interval calculation.
This is used to automatically set the interval when a user selects a time range for a chart.

latestRiskScoreAggregationMethodForParen.description:
Latest Risk Score value aggregation method for parent assets
Possible values are "MAX", "MIN", "AVG"

showYAxisDataZoomForAssetDetailModelOutP.description: Flag controls whether the data zoom functionality is enabled for the Y-axis in the Asset Detail Model OutPut Chart.

alertActivityFetchLimit.description: The Base Limit for fetch call ReliabilityAssetAlertToCaseRelationCaseActivity#fetch. The default value is set to default value 2000 but can be increased.

defaultAlertDetailPreplottedChartInterva.description:
The default {@link Interval} for the `Reliability.AlertDetailPreplottedChart`.
This specifies the granularity at which to display the preplotted chart

modelMonitoringLabelConfig.description:
A list of {@link ThresholdConfig}s which is used to configure a mapping between
{@link ReliabilityMlModel.MonitoringScore#value}, {@link ReliabilityMlModel#monitoringLabel} and the corresponding color.
The values are also considered to be inclusive upper bounds for a given classification label.

Note: [*Order Matters*] The {@link ThresholdConfig} entry at index 0 in #modelClassificationLabelConfig corresponds to the
lowest possible {@link ReliabilityMlModel.MonitoringScore#value}.
The entries in the array are expected be in ascending order of {@link ReliabilityMlModel.MonitoringScore#value}.

defaultTimeseriesPlotPeriod.description: The default time period of data to plot for the Timeseries Plot

assetLevels.description:
An ordered list used to determine which level of hierarchy corresponds to asset hierarchy concepts.
Note: *order matters*; the asset class at index 0 corresponds to the classification of {@link ReliabilityAsset}s
with {@link ReliabilityAsset#depth} equal to 0.

reliabilityAssetLimit.description:
The base limit for fetch call {@link ReliabilityAsset}s on the following pages:
- Alert Page > Filter Panel
- Alert Page > Alert Details > Filter Panel
The default value is set to default value 2000 but can be increased.

featureContributionPrecision.description: How many digits after the decimal to round to for contribution values displayed in the UI.
